notes: Model WPB15ZM, distribution edition made by Zimi.

method: Xiaomi's multilingual user manual (Chinese title marks it as the distribution edition, made by Zimi) names model WPB15ZM with a lithium-polymer 10000 mAh / 3.7 V (37 Wh) battery, 10 W max wireless output, a USB-C input and a USB-A output.
The iFixit teardown names the model, describes removing the board (three screws) and the battery (two glue tapes).

comps.spec: Lithium-polymer battery, 10000 mAh, 3.7 V (37 Wh). Rated capacity 5800 mAh (5 V/2.4 A).
Manual's product overview lists a long-life charge and discharge chip alongside the lithium-polymer battery.
Manual states multiple protection designs against overcharge, over-discharge, overheating and short circuit.
USB-C input rated 5 V 3 A when the USB-A and wireless outputs run together. USB-A output rated 5 V 2.4 A, 9 V 2 A, 12 V 1.5 A max.
Four battery-level LEDs (LED1 to LED4) plus a separate wireless charging indicator, per the manual's indicator tables.
Battery level check push button, labelled Power Check in the manual. The manual describes a press-and-hold of more than 3 seconds on it.
comps.loc: Position not stated in the manual text
